sql: select 'order' k, market_ticker, created_at::text t, action||' '||side||' '||limit_price||'c x'||quantity||' '||status||' '||coalesce(cancel_reason,'') v from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and created_at > '2026-10-17 18:50' union all select 'cxl', market_ticker, created_at::text, action||' '||limit_price||'c '||cancel_reason from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and cancel_reason in ('pre_event','out_of_band','replaced','program_ended') and created_at > '2026-10-15' and status='canceled' and created_at > '2026-10-16' union all select 'fill', market_ticker, filled_at::text, action||' '||side||' '||price||'c x'||quantity from fills where filled_at > '2026-10-17 18:50' union all select 'snap', market_ticker, at::text, best_yes_bid||'/'||best_no_bid from (select distinct on (market_ticker) * from incentive_market_snapshots where market_ticker = 'KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT19-CEAS' order by market_ticker, at desc) x union all select kind, market_ticker, at::text, left(detail_json::text,90) from incentive_collector_events where kind = 'book_sweep' and at > '2026-10-17 18:50' union all select 'cnt', kind, max(at)::text, count(*)::text from incentive_collector_events where kind like 'book_sweep%' group by kind union all select 'off', component, created_at::text, message from system_events where component='limm_resting_sell_off'
